verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents dashboards showing model costs, token usage, tool errors and recent errors, but nothing documents configurable alerts on error rates, cost spikes or eval-score drops. It also never mentions delivering notifications to Slack, PagerDuty or email. Dashboards are an adjacent feature and do not count as alerting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops and get notified in Slack, PagerDuty, or email
